### Added
- **Working-tree continuity** (#33, added in #44). A thread now keeps the files that pi leaves uncommitted, staged and unstaged, on `refs/pi/worktrees/<number>`, and restores them at the start of the next run. When you rewind or fork the conversation, the files rewind too. Two new inputs: `worktree_snapshots` (default `true`) and `worktree_snapshot_exclude`. See [Working-tree continuity](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#working-tree-continuity).

The setup is in a collapsed `Setup` group. The thread, with the git commands that read it, is now at the start of the log. Each follow-up and answer ends with a one-line reminder, so threads that began before this release get it too. Output mode and direct prompts are unchanged. A custom `prompt_template` is still the complete first message, but its follow-ups get the reminder. See [The reply](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.2.2/docs/prompts.md).

      "at": "2026-11-11T18:28:18Z",
      "body": "### New
- **pi-durable extensions** (#31): packages whose `package.json` has `pi.durable`, such as [pit](https://github.com/cv/pit) v0.35.0's `pit/durable` (`extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.0`), add their tools and prompt sections to every conversation. They load with the action's own pi-durable and chord. New inputs: `trust_project` (default `false`: whether the extension may run the repository's own configuration, such as pit's `.pi/functions`) and `agent_dir`.
- **Asynchronous questions on GitHub**: when an extension asks something (`ui.confirm`, `ui.select`, `ui.input`), pi-action posts it as a comment with checkboxes (or asks for an `/answer` reply) and the run ends; nothing waits on a timer. Ticking a box (an `issue_comment` *edited* event, from someone with write access) or replying `/answer ...` delivers the answer to the thread, and pi continues. Add `edited` to your workflow's `issue_comment` types and match the question marker in its `if:`; see the README.
- The agent's tools get `GH_TOKEN` (from `github_token`) and a `github-actions[bot]` git identity when they aren't already set, so `gh` and `git commit` work out of the box.

### Fixes
- A one-off push failure of the thread ref (`remote rejected ... (failed)`) no longer stops the thread from being saved for the rest of the run: only real fast-forward conflicts do, and other failures are retried.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0
"
    },
    {
      "tag": "v2.1.0",
      "at": "2026-11-11T08:03:19Z",
      "body": "### New
- **Model providers from pi extensions** (#30, for #24): a new `extensions` input takes npm package specs or workspace paths of pi extensions. They are installed into the runner's temp directory without lifecycle scripts, and providers they register (both `registerProvider` forms) can be selected with `provider`/`model`. Other extension features (tools, commands, events, OAuth) are ignored with a warning; a load failure fails the run. Extensions run with the job's token and secrets in reach: see the README's security notes.

### Fixes
- The `if: always()` step now pushes the `pr_number` thread, as the main step does (#29).
- Prompt templates render in one pass and insert values literally, so `$&` or `{{diff}}` inside an issue body are no longer expanded (#29).
- Webhook payloads whose issue, PR, or comment has no user are skipped instead of failing the run (#28).

### Internal
- Biome replaced by oxlint (type-aware, every category but nursery as errors) and oxfmt (#28).
- About 1,400 fewer lines with the same interface: flatter input parsing, a simpler run, one git helper (#29).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0
"

- The agent's tools get `GH_TOKEN` (from `github_token`) and a `github-actions[bot]` git identity when they aren't already set, so `gh` and `git commit` work out of the box.

### Fixes
- A one-off push failure of the thread ref (`remote rejected ... (failed)`) no longer stops the thread from being saved for the rest of the run: only real fast-forward conflicts do, and other failures are retried.
